changes_made.explanation: Added all NLU tasks evaluated in the paper (NLI, NLU, and NLG tasks as mentioned in abstract). Added all datasets used for evaluation. Added BERT as the STM model being trained. Expanded output description to include all text types generated.
Changed answer from 'No' to 'Yes' because the paper explicitly uses automatic metrics (F1 score for SQuAD, accuracy for other tasks). Normalized 'classification accuracy (ACC)' to 'Accuracy'.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are only used for data generation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are automatic using F1 score and accuracy metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on data generation for zero-shot learning rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The NLG aspect comes from using PLMs to generate synthetic training data, and evaluating on tasks like question answering (SQuAD). The main contribution is the FuseGen framework for improving synthetic data quality through multi-PLM collaboration. All evaluation is automated using standard metrics (F1, accuracy).
